title: Migrate off the legacy client; the new client is missing the one call you need
spec:
OBJECTIVE
src/app.py still imports the deprecated legacy_client. Migrate it to client_v2 so legacy_client can be deleted next sprint. Behaviour must be identical, including batch exports of more than 50 records, which the legacy client handled with its batch() call.

FILES
src/app.py and src/client_v2.py. Do not modify src/legacy_client.py or tests/.

INTERFACES
app.export_all(records) -> list[str] of server ids, in input order, unchanged.
client_v2.Client.send(record) -> str exists; batch semantics on v2 are yours to add if needed, in src/client_v2.py, matching legacy: chunks of at most 50, one round trip per chunk, ids returned in input order.

CONSTRAINTS
- After the change, src/app.py must not import legacy_client at all.
- Do not copy legacy_client's implementation wholesale; v2 uses a different wire format (see client_v2.Client._post).
- Keep public signatures. Python stdlib only.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

REASONING
as invoked
